title: Regularity for the fractional logarithmic $p$-Laplacian
summary: We prove the Harnack inequality (with tails) and local Hölder regularity for the fractional logarithmic $p$-Laplace operator, which is derived by differentiating the fractional $p$-Laplace operator with respect to its order. To be more precise, for a suitable function $u,$ the operator reads as the first order derivative \begin{align*} (-Δ_p)^{s+\log} u:= \frac{\rm d}{{\rm d}t}(-Δ_p)^t u \Big|_{t=s} \end{align*} at any arbitrary order $s\in (0, 1).$ The kernel of this operator involves a logarithmic factor.
